case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Esporta le regole firewall attive in fw.txt
case.goal: Esporta le regole firewall attive in fw.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Step: read the active firewall ruleset.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `fw.txt`.
commands: Get-NetFirewallProfile | Select Name,Enabled; Get-NetFirewallRule -Enabled True | Select -First 20 DisplayName,Direction,Action
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `fw.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.
reference_solution: Run: Get-NetFirewallProfile | Select Name,Enabled; Get-NetFirewallRule -Enabled True | Select -First 20 DisplayName,Direction,Action
